scope: Bounded engineering cross-round pilot; single task, not benchmark score or noninferiority test
primary_path: WatchdogSupervisor -> OpenPISkillRuntime -> TargetWS -> OpenPI -> SessionVerifier -> ResultWriter
evaluation: same full OS; immutable version clone; lessons readable; persistent writes blocked; evaluation excluded from learning

arms.A: Original OS feedback and recovery; shared strict parser fix; fixed 384 token ceiling
arms.B: Fixed legal fast/slow rule and 384 token ceiling. No admissible fast recovery exists yet, so execution falls back to original slow path
arms.C: Same legal pool; learn next-version token ceiling from at least two validated development completions: min(384,max(192,ceil((2*max_tokens_seen+32)/32)*32)); one fallback to 384 if output is truncated/invalid

laya: Shadow only; constrain options before calling; bypass if only escalation is legal; validate returned candidate and freshness; no training
capabilities: All start at identical pretrained weights and empty lessons/skills. Existing lessons are read; recovery skills remain unavailable until separately validated
resource: 187, HCU0 policy, HCU1 Qwen, same image/CPU limits, serial groups with fresh services and warm/cold costs separated
stop: Abort on chain infrastructure error, incomplete required evidence, persistent evaluation mutation, duplicate workload or resource conflict; native task failures remain counted
interpretation: Budget change is a narrow learning probe; unchanged realized latency is a valid null result. B can coincide with A while Laya is inadmissible; cannot claim a validated fast/slow algorithm or trained recovery skill
